C-DESIGN-MOTION-GOVERNANCE.Summary: Make Apple-inspired product design, motion advising and independent design audit a mandatory specialist path for future Kafedra Planner UI changes inside the existing GRACE 4 lifecycle.
C-DESIGN-MOTION-GOVERNANCE.Problem: Kafedra Planner already has a stable product design guide and a kafedra-design role, but motion selection, reduced-motion decisions and post-implementation design audit are not separate durable responsibilities and are not fail-closed for UI-scoped GRACE plans.

Goals.Goal: Extend the product design contract with restrained Apple-inspired clarity, continuity, direct manipulation, stable geometry and predictable motion without copying Apple assets or introducing a decorative visual layer.
Add a kafedra-motion specialist that converts interaction intent into a measurable motion brief backed by a local semantic catalog of all 123 current Reactiive demos.
Add an independent kafedra-design-audit specialist that reviews implemented UI after feature delivery and before test/release handoff.

Add deterministic repository governance so a GRACE plan that writes public UI files must explicitly route design, motion, implementation, design audit and tests and cover desktop, mobile and reduced motion.
Represent the design governance and motion knowledge base in GRACE context, graph and verification artifacts so later orchestrators can discover the workflow.

Constraints.Constraint: The existing GRACE 4 lifecycle remains the outer governance mechanism; no parallel lifecycle or second source of truth is introduced.
The application runtime, SQLite schema, domain behavior and offline bundle dependency graph must not change.

Reactiive is an inspiration/reference source only. The repository stores original semantic descriptions, classification, measured parameters and source paths/links, not redistributed upstream component source.
The core UI must remain fully functional offline and must not depend on Reactiive, Reanimated, Skia, a remote design service or an LLM at runtime.
Motion must never be the sole carrier of state, must support prefers-reduced-motion and must not add decorative delay to frequent operational actions.
Stable geometry and the adaptive UX safe-default/rank-only/domain-derived/never-learn contract remain authoritative.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Restyle every existing Kafedra Planner screen in this governance change.
Add a frontend framework, animation runtime library, remote font, CDN asset or visual dependency.
Change application data, migrations, release version or product workflows.
Repackage or redistribute the Reactiive demos repository or create a competing animation library.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Repository-local skills exist for kafedra-design, kafedra-motion and kafedra-design-audit with explicit GRACE handoffs and distinct responsibilities.
The motion knowledge base indexes all 123 current Reactiive demos by retrieval family and keeps exact source-derived facts distinct from semantic interpretation and Kafedra recommendations.

The product design and motion documentation define a calm Apple-inspired visual language, direct manipulation, continuity, timing policy, material/opacity restraint, accessibility, reduced-motion and performance rules.

A deterministic design governance check passes on the repository and fails for a UI-scoped GRACE plan that omits design, motion, independent audit, tests, desktop/mobile acceptance or prefers-reduced-motion handling.
The design governance check rejects an invalid specialist order and accepts design then motion then implementation then independent design audit then tests.
AGENTS and Codex role routing require the design audit after implementation for UI changes and preserve existing data, testing, release and GRACE ownership.
GRACE context, graph and verification expose the design-governance and motion-reference boundaries and validate with the pinned GRACE toolchain.
npm run design:check, focused design-governance tests, npm run check and npm run docs:check pass without adding a runtime or offline dependency.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Design governance regression evidence plus unchanged-head GRACE, project and release checks show that the new specialist path is durable without modifying runtime behavior or the database.

Assumptions.Assumption: The verified base revision is main commit 02d103f667bd5f77895b74ad5532e882c3903ffb and tree 880331c27287a0c0754e1207a15812ff722f164b.
The browser UI remains rooted in public/ for the current architecture; if that boundary moves, M-DESIGN-GOVERNANCE must be updated in a later approved change.
Issue 195 is the human-visible work item for this change.
